title: Misleading Deepfake Video of Trump Mocking Zelenskyy for Clothing Goes Viral on Facebook

behaviors.text: In March 2025, an AI-generated deepfake video of a person criticizing Ukrainian President a person for his clothing circulated widely on Facebook.

In the video, Trump mocks Zelenskyy by calling him "Temu Zelenskyy." The video was created by a parody YouTube channel using AI voice and face synthesis tools, but it was reportedly mistaken by some viewers as real.
